integrity: Proof from exact antiderivative and one-root derivative; numerical grid supports but does not replace all-parameter proof. No independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic single leaky store, no saturation capacity, linear drying, fixed ordered pulse volumes, phenomenological saturating response and no feedback of assimilation on water balance. Not a field-calibrated crop-yield prediction; general impulse-control priority not fully excluded. A relevant 1968 timing study was identified but not inspected in full.
title: Exact activation and midpoint-crossing laws for two fixed water pulses under saturating uptake
